description: This file defines interfaces for warning reporting within the WPEFramework, including warning event and reporting control interfaces, with mechanisms to report warnings, fetch category info, and manage category lists.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects, including serialization, deserialization, categorization, and warning status.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units that handle warning events and category information management.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Interface for control objects that configure warning categories, including exclusion and configuration settings, clone functionality.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event identified by an array and warning information.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves category info including default status, enabled state, exclusions, and configurations.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a warning reporting control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a warning reporting control from the category list.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Excludes a specific category from reporting within the control.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the control with specific settings.
